svg.title: Three ways to get the futures tape for deep trades: sampled only, streaming, or completion at night, with the coverage and the cost of each.
svg.text: Futures tape for deep trades: three ways (ES and NQ)
API data stream on the gateway
that live trading uses; one restart
Trade side: quote rule for every
IBKR: up to 4 of 6 history requests
All three keep the same table and panel. Research only, no orders.
